svg.title: find_anomalies flags the entities past the alarm budget
svg.desc: An agent calls find_anomalies and explain_anomaly over MCP; on the right, the population of accounts by evidence: the alarm-budget boundary (conformal p = 0.05) draws in, the five entities past it light up, and the top one is explained by the dimension carrying most of its evidence. Distance from the centre is real (sqrt of the evidence in bits, -log2 conformal_p, over the budget's 4.32 bits); angles are illustrative.
svg.text: The alarm budget is exact: no labels, no tuning.
